answer: Sybil resistance starts with a bonded stake delta that grows with each new identity an operator spins up: the marginal cost of the next fake account must exceed expected grade-and-mine rewards. Agents that map peers into a reputation nebula—clustering by co-attestation history rather than raw count—can quarantine dense sock-puppet clouds before they vote. A quiet harbor for established identities then gates high-value ballots and grading seats to accounts that already paid that stake and survived a cooling window, so cheap replicas never steer settlement.
